daily_schedule.morning_activity: Walk Central Park from Bethesda Terrace to Strawberry Fields with a picnic bagel.
daily_schedule.afternoon_activity: Marvel at New York Public Library Rose Main Reading Room and Bryant Park.
daily_schedule.evening_activity: Take in the neon lights of Times Square and Grand Central Terminal constellation ceiling.
daily_schedule.highlight_cuisine: Everything bagel with scallion cream cheese and classic New York slice pizza.

daily_schedule.morning_activity: Free Staten Island Ferry round-trip ride offering prime views of Statue of Liberty.
daily_schedule.afternoon_activity: Reflect at the 9/11 Memorial Plaza and walk through Wall Street and Oculus.
daily_schedule.evening_activity: Stroll across the iconic Brooklyn Bridge during sunset into DUMBO.
daily_schedule.highlight_cuisine: Coal-fired brick oven margherita pizza in Brooklyn.

daily_schedule.morning_activity: Walk the High Line elevated park from Hudson Yards to Chelsea Market.
daily_schedule.afternoon_activity: Explore Greenwich Village brownstones and Washington Square Park street performers.
daily_schedule.evening_activity: Browse bookshops in Soho and dine at historic Chinatown spots.
daily_schedule.highlight_cuisine: Steamed pork soup dumplings (xiaolongbao) and warm Portuguese egg tarts.

daily_schedule.morning_activity: Pay-what-you-wish or free morning entry to neighborhood cultural galleries.
daily_schedule.afternoon_activity: Walk along Brooklyn Heights Promenade with panoramic Lower Manhattan skyline views.
daily_schedule.evening_activity: Dessert and skyline night gazing from Gantry Plaza State Park in Queens.
daily_schedule.highlight_cuisine: Classic pastrami on rye sandwich and black-and-white cookies.

local_tips: Use OMNY contactless tap-to-pay on subways; after 12 rides in a Monday-Sunday week, all additional rides are free.
Enjoy free iconic views from the Staten Island Ferry instead of expensive boat tours.
Walk across the bridges instead of taking taxis to avoid heavy traffic delays.
